items.title: Godement resolution of a bounded below complex by a flasque complex, stalkwise a homotopy equivalence

items.difficulty_reason: For a ringed space (X, O_X) and a bounded below complex F of O_X-modules, the lemma produces a quasi-isomorphism F to G with G a bounded below complex of flasque modules whose stalkwise map is a homotopy equivalence of complexes of O_{X,x}-modules (statement lines 7080-7091). The proof transplants the one sheaf resolution to complexes by viewing complexes of O_X-modules as an abelian category and repeating the construction with the adjoint pair f^* and f_*: one obtains a resolution of F by the f_*f^* iterates, each of whose terms is termwise flasque and whose stalkwise comparison with F[0] is a homotopy equivalence of complexes of complexes (proof lines 7093-7120). The total complex G of that double complex is then shown to be bounded below, with each term a finite direct sum of flasque terms, because F is bounded below; the stalkwise homotopy equivalence statement is transferred from the double complex to its totalization by the homotopy lemma for complexes of complexes (proof lines 7121-7137). The claim is H2: the resolution itself is cited from the preceding lemma, and the content is the passage to complexes and the boundedness and flasqueness bookkeeping.
